description: Single-panel network layout composed of many circles (nodes) and numerous straight gray connecting lines (edges). No axes or grids; marks spread across the full canvas with clusters and overlaps.

components.description: All connecting edges: many straight gray line segments spanning various directions and lengths, densely crossing the central area and linking distant clusters.
All nodes: multiple filled circles distributed across the canvas. Similar sizes, different fill colors indicating visual grouping; dense central cluster with several peripheral clusters.

primary.explanation: Approximate count of edges; each edge is positioned by its two node endpoints across the 2D canvas.
Approximate count of nodes; each circle is positioned with independent x,y coordinates in a 2D scatter/network layout.

secondary.explanation: y used together with x to place each node (scatter-like).
